prospect_discovery.agency_exclusion_scope: multilingual strong self-description phrases for web/design/development/app/software/UX/marketing/advertising/SEO/branding/digital/commerce agencies and similar providers
prospect_discovery.source_semantic_filter: directory-provider self domains and obvious institutional/navigation candidates are rejected; manufacturing-directory candidates require manufacturing/industrial self-description on the official site before candidate write
prospect_discovery.target_fill: bounded by PROSPECT_DISCOVERY_MAX_TOTAL and processed after target-policy and source-semantic filtering in preferred-country order
prospect_discovery.source_run_history: ProspectSourceRuns records processed-source status, yield, duplicates, duration and bounded error text when the optional bootstrap tab exists

prospect_qualification.input_boundary: new/unassessed discovered or hold candidates are prioritized; previously assessed discovered/hold/qualified/rejected rows are only rechecked after the configured age or an explicit bounded recheck
prospect_qualification.score_contract: ICP 0-3 + one primary evidence-bound website opportunity 0-3 + active signal 0-2 + offer fit 0-2; A=8-10, B=6-7, C=0-5
quality_rules: one primary opportunity severity is scored instead of summing generic gaps
manufacturer-only pages use conservative ICP/offer-fit defaults
A requires an official-page evidence-bound fact and idea
fetch/evidence failures become UNSCORED hold instead of C/rejected
agency/provider and self targets fail closed

zero_touch_prepare.flow: prospect_discovery -> prospect_candidate_sanitizer -> prospect_signal_discovery -> prospect_qualification -> contact_enrichment -> prospect_intelligence -> private_outreach_config -> outreach_prepare
zero_touch_prepare.input_boundary: only A-qualified prospects with ContactCandidates.ready can produce copy
zero_touch_prepare.private_config_contract: US postal address is read at runtime from the private Webactueel Outreach Config Sheet, masked before export to GITHUB_ENV and never supplied through a non-secret repository variable
zero_touch_prepare.queue_contract: writes status=prepared, compliance_status=manual_review and blank compliance_basis; stale automated prepared rows that are no longer A+ready are reconciled to manual_review; it never creates approved/sendable state
zero_touch_prepare.copy_contract: deterministic LeadPromo NL/EN copy with canonical one follow-up; US prepare requires the private postal address and commercial-message identification

sender_readiness.provider_managed_relay: when include:spf.mijn.host is the required SPF token and SPF is proven green, a shared mijn.host relay without one explicit fixed egress IP is represented as provider_managed; no per-egress-IP reputation or global placement is claimed

outreach_delivery.private_config_contract: the physical postal address is loaded from the private Config Sheet and masked before later steps; no plaintext postal address repository variable is used by the active workflow
outreach_delivery.live_gate: sender_readiness -> website target/evidence -> LeadPromo copy -> compliance -> SMTP
outreach_delivery.target_evidence_contract: approved queue rows require source=website_scan:<JSON> with same-domain evidence_url, analysis_type website|webshop and exact idea text present in body; official homepage is rechecked against agency/provider exclusions before SMTP
outreach_delivery.international_copy_contract: controlled NL and EN LeadPromo champions only; CTA/opt-out/signature language may not be mixed
outreach_delivery.us_gate: US requires a private-config physical postal address present in body plus clear commercial/advertising identification before SMTP
outreach_delivery.uk_gate: GB unsolicited route requires subscriber_type=corporate evidence plus clear Ltd/Limited/LLP/PLC company form; uncertainty blocks

scanner_tools.trigger_when: explicit website audit or Leads technical evidence-gap crawl orchestration is needed
explicit audit or Leads technical evidence-gap desktop/mobile browser evidence is needed
supplemental link signals are needed for the scoped evidence question
performance context is the scoped evidence question
technology context is necessary to interpret the scoped evidence question
a completed explicit audit or evidence-gap scan returns to Leads

boundaries: The website scanner remains read-only and optional; it never changes lead fit, priority, compliance, send permission or outreach state.
Prospect discovery finds approved-source company/domain candidates only and receives no mail credentials.

Prospect discovery allows NL by default, prioritizes US then NL then configured remaining sources, and applies agency/provider plus source-semantic filtering before candidate writes and target-fill accounting.

Directory provider infrastructure, obvious institutional/navigation candidates and manufacturing-directory category drift are rejected before qualification when sufficiently evidenced; fetch uncertainty defers rather than fabricates rejection.
Directory sitemap sources accept only bounded public XML sitemap/urlset data; same-host sitemap-index children are capped at three and external child sitemaps are ignored.
Prospect source runs are provenance/health evidence only; their status, yield, duplicates, duration or errors never qualify a lead or create send permission.
Prospect target-fill is bounded by the existing discovery hard cap; failure to reach the requested target is reported as a target gap, never fabricated as completion.
Prospect observations record discovery provenance and rediscovery freshness only; they never approve, qualify or enrich a lead.
Scheduled prospect discovery remains validate-only unless PROSPECT_DISCOVERY_ENABLED=true explicitly promotes the scheduled run to discover mode.

Prospect intelligence is derived/advisory only; signals, entities, freshness, source metrics, evidence edges and lookalikes never change Customer Potential, compliance, contact promotion, copy or send permission.
Scheduled prospect intelligence remains validate-only unless PROSPECT_INTELLIGENCE_ENABLED=true explicitly promotes the scheduled run to refresh mode.

Prospect signal discovery inspects bounded official-site evidence for hiring and deterministic WordPress/WooCommerce markers only; it never harvests contacts, changes Customer Potential, qualifies leads, changes compliance or enables transport.
Prospect signal rediscovery may update or expire its own official-site signal rows after a successful scan; it never rewrites externally supplied signal rows.
Scheduled prospect signal discovery remains validate-only unless PROSPECT_SIGNAL_DISCOVERY_ENABLED=true explicitly promotes the scheduled run to discover mode.

Prospect qualification may automatically apply the Leads Customer Potential contract only to bounded official-site evidence, stores the component scores and primary evidence in ProspectQualifications, treats evidence-fetch failures as UNSCORED hold, prioritizes new candidates and never grants compliance or send permission.
Contact enrichment runs only after qualification, inspects bounded official-site pages, never guesses an address and never creates send permission.

The weekday zero-touch prepare workflow may discover, sanitize, collect signals, qualify, enrich, refresh intelligence and generate deterministic LeadPromo copy, but only A-qualified plus ready-contact rows can be prepared and every prepared row stays compliance manual_review with no send permission.
Stale automated prepared rows that stop being A-qualified or contact-ready are reconciled fail-closed to manual_review rather than remaining transport-ready.

The active workflows obtain the physical postal address from a private service-account-readable Config Sheet, mask it before exporting to later steps, and do not use a plaintext repository variable for it.
Approved outreach rows require same-domain website_scan evidence and the exact analyzed idea in the mail; the target homepage is rechecked against agency/provider terms before SMTP.

Current targeting allows NL while webactueel.nl and all subdomains remain blocked. NL/EER live outreach still requires a valid evidenced compliance basis. US live additionally requires commercial-message identification and the private-config physical postal address in the body. GB unsolicited live requires a verified corporate subscriber route; uncertainty fails closed.
Sender readiness is technical diagnostics only; proven mijn.host shared-relay mode may be represented as provider_managed without pretending one fixed egress IP or per-IP reputation is known.
Inbox placement can send only manual controlled probes to at most five configured seed inboxes and never touches OutreachQueue recipients.
Mailbox draft testing is IMAP-only, self-addressed, explicitly triggered and never calls SMTP or changes Lead/Sheet state.
Dashboard formulas are readout only and never mutate Leads decisions.

Leads policy remains the source of truth for qualification, copy and compliance contracts; repository automation may execute bounded qualification and prepare-only copy but never auto-approve compliance or live transport.
The active direct SMTP route requires no Reoon dependency; legacy verification columns remain transport-compatible only.
Live outreach runs sender readiness, website target/evidence, LeadPromo copy and compliance gates before SMTP, remains fail-closed, and is never executed by CI.
Reply, bounce and opt-out readback stop follow-up state and maintain suppression evidence.
No secret or private postal-address value belongs in repository files, logs, test fixtures or artifacts.
